findingClosures.rationale: The corrected Polish message explicitly names a local copy of the short-lived password as the eviction object. "z użyciem danych z pamięci podręcznej" attaches cache use to verification, not removal. It therefore no longer suggests deleting the retained offline verifier. "po weryfikacji" preserves ordering without inventing successful authentication; the unchanged disconnected-state clause still denies knowledge of remote changes. It matches the actual evict kind/actor/attribute rather than mechanically repeating the shared English verification verb.
